Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: target litres per 100 km, the fleet figure for the fuel tax return, the card discount, the price alert limit and the plan for fuel cost per km.
Check Trucks, Drivers and Fuel Tax Regions. Put your own rated litres per 100 km and your own tax per litre in the yellow cells.
Enter every fill on Fuel Purchases. The amount, the net price, the km since the last fill, the litres per 100 km and the network check fill in by themselves.
Every week, enter the statement of the fuel card provider on Fuel Card Statements and read the check: a wrong price or a gap to your own fills shows in red.
Keep Fuel Price by Month and Station Price List current, and read Cheapest Stops by Lane before the dispatcher plans a load.
Enter the km and litres bought by region each quarter on Km and Litres by Region. Fuel Tax Return works out the net litres and the tax due or credit; Fuel Tax Filing Calendar tracks the due dates.
Log the bulk tank deliveries and issues on Bulk Tank Log, and the reefer unit hours on Reefer Fuel Use.
Follow the missing receipts on Missing Fuel Receipts and the card discount on Fuel Card Discounts until each one is closed.
Use Fuel Surcharge Recovered to compare the surcharge you billed with the extra fuel cost, and Fuel Budget to compare the plan with the real cost.
Take an odometer reading of every truck about once a month on Odometer Readings.

Use the 14 calculators: cost per km, litres per 100 km, net price, fuel tax, litres in a region, a cheaper stop, the surcharge needed, a bulk tank, reefer fuel, a trip budget, the card value, idling, a price swing and a what-if grid.
Read Fuel Dashboard and Charts every week: fuel cost, price, litres per 100 km, card discount, surcharge recovery and the fuel tax.
Know which truck costs you money before the next breakdown
Know which truck costs you money before it breaks down

every workshop job on a truck or trailer with labour, parts, downtime days and whether the invoice is paid, unpaid or overdue
Breakdowns with the revenue they cost
days down and loads lost are priced at your revenue per day, and a truck with no return date shows as in the shop
Repair cost per km and rank
repairs divided by the km driven rank the trucks, so the one that keeps breaking down stands out
Repair or replace with the real numbers
old payment, repairs and downtime are set against the payment of a newer truck to give the saving per month
steer, drive and trailer tyres with the km left on each, plus a replace-soon flag against your own limit
every tyre job priced against the km the old tyre did, so retreads and blowouts can be compared
payments, servicing, repairs, tyres and insurance by quarter give a cost per km and per day for each truck
stock value and a reorder flag for filters, belts, lamps, hoses and fluids, with the cost of the reorder and the supplier phone
money claimed back from workshops with the open amount and the days since the claim
engine hours of the refrigerated trailers with the hours left to the next unit service
maintenance cost taken from the log against your monthly budget, with truck days out and fleet availability

Trucks with the driver and year
The eight trucks with their driver and model year; every sheet picks the truck from this list and age figures fill in from the year.
The ten trailers with their type and model year; trailer jobs, defects and use pick from this list.
The owner and seven drivers with the phone used by the message links; truck jobs and readings find the driver here.
Workshops, mobile repair, tyre shops and parts suppliers
Every workshop and supplier with phone, hourly rate, response time and rating; the jobs, spend and average job cost fill in from the maintenance log.
Maintenance log with labour, parts and downtime
One row per workshop job on a truck or trailer; total cost, the asset, the payment state and the phone numbers fill in by themselves.
Service schedule per truck and service
Three scheduled services for each truck: the next km, the km left, the estimated due date and an overdue flag fill in from the last service and the odometer.
Every unplanned stop of a truck: days down, loads lost and the revenue lost at your revenue per day; a truck with no back-in-service date shows as in the shop.
Repair cost per truck and per km
Repairs and unplanned jobs per truck for the year to date and the last 12 months; the repair cost per km, the rank and a review flag fill in.
Tyre jobs with cost per 1000 km
One row per tyre job: new fits, retreads, punctures and rotations; total cost and the cost per 1000 km of the old tyre fill in, blowouts stand out.
Steer, drive and trailer tyres of every truck with the km fitted and the expected life; km left and a replace-soon flag fill in from the odometer.
Spare parts stock with reorder points
Filters, belts, lamps, hoses and fluids on the shelf: stock value, a reorder flag and the cost of the reorder fill in; the supplier phone is looked up.
Repairs claimed back from the workshop or supplier: the open amount, the age of an open claim and the phone of the vendor fill in.
Replacement offers for the older trucks: the old monthly cost (payment, repairs and downtime) against the new payment gives the saving per month and a verdict.
One reading per truck at the end of each month; the km in the month and the km per day fill in from the reading before.
Every loan on a truck or trailer: payment, months left, interest rate and balance; the total still to pay, the interest left and the end date fill in.
Defects found at inspections with the date fixed; the days open, a flag for a defect open over the limit and the driver phone fill in.
Monthly engine hours of the three refrigerated trailers with the hour reading of the next service; the hours left and a service-soon flag fill in.
Downtime, availability and maintenance budget by month
One row per month: planned and unplanned truck days out, trucks, availability, the maintenance cost taken from the log and the budget with the variance.
Annual cost of ownership by quarter
Each truck by quarter: payments, servicing, repairs, tyres and insurance with the km driven; cost per km and cost per day fill in. Fuel and driver pay are not in it.
Loads, days in use and idle days of every trailer by quarter with the usual truck; utilisation and a flag against your target fill in.
